_comment: HQ Evolution external-discovery watchlist (spec section 9/43). Each topic must answer 'why is this relevant to TJR HQ?' before being searched — no generic tech-trend scanning. Add a topic only when it ties to a real HQ component, gap, or cost. github_query uses GitHub's search-qualifiers syntax (https://docs.github.com/search-github/searching-on-github).

topics.why_relevant: HQ already runs a bespoke Model Router (core/model-router) that self-improvement's own router_client.py depends on. A more mature open-source router could reduce maintenance burden or improve routing quality for the same workload.
topics.known_gap: custom single-service router with no fallback pooling beyond escalation

topics.why_relevant: HQ's episodic/knowledge stores (tests/test_episodic_memory.py, knowledge/) are hand-rolled. A proven memory architecture could improve recall quality or reduce the surface area HQ has to maintain itself.
topics.known_gap: no dedicated retrieval-evaluation harness for episodic memory

topics.why_relevant: Findings/briefs/advisory all depend on retrieval quality but HQ has no systematic retrieval eval; a lightweight OSS eval harness could catch regressions before they reach the Captain.
topics.known_gap: retrieval quality is currently judged qualitatively, not measured

topics.why_relevant: Telegram and Briefs currently risk independently re-synthesising the same intelligence with separate LLM calls (see spec example: canonical Brief vs duplicate channel narration) — a caching/synthesis-reuse pattern could cut redundant calls.
topics.known_gap: no shared synthesis cache between delivery channels

topics.why_relevant: core/model-router/call_log.jsonl is a flat append-only log with no queryable tracing; an OSS observability layer could surface routing/latency/cost regressions the self-improvement collector currently can't see.
topics.known_gap: call_log.jsonl has no aggregation, alerting, or trace correlation

topics.why_relevant: OSINT/technical collectors rely on RSS/API polling; a maintained browser-automation agent could extend coverage to sources with no feed, if a real coverage gap is confirmed by Technical/Health OSINT findings.
HQ already integrates several MCP servers; new MCP servers may close a specific integration gap (e.g. a data source Technical OSINT currently polls by hand) rather than being adopted for novelty.
topics.known_gap: integration effort tracked ad hoc, not evaluated against a standard checklist

topics.why_relevant: batch_coding.py's engineering-handoff pipeline is a single-shot coder; a proven task-decomposition pattern could improve handoff success rate if HandoffPRStrategy's PR acceptance rate is ever found to be low.
topics.known_gap: no measured PR-acceptance rate for engineering handoffs yet

topics.github_query: local llm inference server efficient quantized
topics.why_relevant: Any task_type currently routed to a paid model in TASK_POLICY could move to a capable local model if quality holds, directly lowering per-call cost.
topics.known_gap: no per-task-type cost/quality tradeoff review has been run
